Opportunity Bromley (699 followers)
What a morning!
A huge thank you to all the buyers and local organisations who made today’s Health & Social Care Meet the Buyer event such a success.
 - Real conversations.
 - Real opportunities.
 - Real connections across Bromley.

Great to see local VCSEs and SMEs directly engaging with organisations who can genuinely commission, procure and partner.
More to come…watch this space!!

#OpportunityBromley #LocalGrowth #BromleyBusiness  Excelcare  Oxleas NHS Foundation Trust  Bromley GP Alliance  Change Grow Live  BTSE (Bromley Third Sector Enterprise)  Bromley Works  Peabody  Federation of Small Businesses (FSB)  Daniel Murray   Nina Terry

Christopher Evans (Chief Executive at COMMUNITY LINKS BROMLEY — COMMUNITY LINKS BROMLEY — United Kingdom, United Kingdom)
Super networking opportunity - Discussed successful Innovation Fund bids - More to come - and the resulting employment  opportunities for small commnity facing charities; mentoring support and services available for small charities; recycling IT equipement and putting the resource available for community usage. Well done Opportunity Bromley

Amazing event!! , thank you very much to the opportunity Bromley team  🙂

Fantastic event @   Opportunity Bromley - I’d love to see this one run again in the future and more like it - so many good conversations that I just didn’t have enough time to speak to all the people on stands - love that Bromley is doing events like this 👏
